mapper.select: select id, room_id, user_id, start_time, end_time, user_count from Room_history where room_id = #{roomId} and DATE(start_time) = DATE(#{date})
select id, room_id, user_id, start_time, end_time, user_count from Room_history where user_id = #{userId} order by start_time desc
mapper.insert: insert into Room_history(room_id, user_id, start_time, end_time, user_count) values(#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{userCount})
